To find stationary points, first differentiate f(x) to get f'(x). Then set f'(x)=0 and solve for x. These x-values are where the slope is zero. Next, substitute these back into f(x) to determine the corresponding y-coordinates. Finally, analyze the second derivative or use a sign chart to classify each point as a maximum, minimum, or saddle point.
